title: Some Characteristics of Aerated Lagoons
markdown:
| No. | Characteristics | Facultative Aerated Lagoons | Fully Aerobic | Extended Aeration System (for comparison) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1. | Detention time, days | 3 - 5 | 2 - 3 | 0.5 - 1.0 |
| 2. | Depth, m | 2.5 – 5.0 | 2.5 – 4.0 | 2.5 - 4.0 |
| 3. | Land required, m²/person | 0.15 - 0.30 | 0.10 - 0.20 |  |
| 4. | BOO removal efficiency % | 80 - 90 | 50 - 60 | 95 - 98 |
| 5. | Overall BOD removal rate, K (A) | 0.6 – 0.8 | 1-1.5 | 20 - 30 |
| 6. | Suspended solids in lagoon, mg/l | 40 - 150 | 150 - 350 | 3,000 - 5,000 |
| 7. | VSS/SS | 0.6 | 0.8 | 0. 6 |
| 8. | Desirable power level (B) | 0.75 | 2.75 - 6.0 | 15 - 18 |
| 9 | Power requirement, kWh/person/year | 12 - 15 | 12 - 14 | 16 - 20 |
notes: (A) Per day at 20 degree C for soluble BOD only; (B)-in watts per cum of lagoon volume
Printed as "BOO removal efficiency %" in row 4 (letter O for D); flagged, not corrected.
Row 7 (VSS/SS) prints the Extended Aeration value as "0. 6" with a space between the point and the 6; the other two cells print "0.6" and "0.8". Preserved verbatim.
Row 3 has no printed value in the Extended Aeration column; the empty cell is preserved as an empty string.
Row 9 prints "9" without a full stop while rows 1 to 8 print "1." to "8.".

transcription.method: direct visual reading of 144 dpi annotation-cleaned full-page renders plus 288-900 dpi crops of the source regions; no OCR
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every value, exponent, subscript, printed spelling and printed error was read from the rendered page image. No distinct second inspection performed; record is a draft pending review.
